question: Why is there no real sequence or fixed time for satisfaction in this awareness?
premises: In awareness made of light, no sequence truly exists.
There is never an absence of awareness.
Satisfaction therefore is not bound by time.
inference: Because awareness is ever-present and luminous, ritual sequence and temporal restriction do not ultimately apply to satisfaction.
uncertainties: The doctrinal force of 'timeless satisfaction' in ritual practice may be stronger than a purely philosophical claim.
plain_english: In awareness made of light there is no real sequence at all, for there is never any absence of awareness. Therefore, satisfaction is timeless.
